title: Impact of Credit Score Threshold on Loan Default Rates
research_question: Does crossing a specific credit score threshold for loan approval influence the likelihood of defaulting on loans? This study examines the causal effect of meeting a minimum credit score requirement on subsequent loan default rates.
data_description: The dataset includes 600 observations with columns: running_var (credit score), treated (indicator for scores above the threshold), and y (default rate). The data captures individuals near the credit score cutoff for loan approval.

ground_truth.identification_strategy: The analysis exploits the discontinuity at the credit score threshold to identify the causal effect.
ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Crossing the credit score threshold increases the default rate.
